title: Final Probability P2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and express the probability P2 for the transition from n=1 to n=2.

title: Final Probability P3
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the probability P3 for the transition from n=1 to n=3 is zero.

title: Perturbation Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct setup and evaluation of the matrix element H'_{21} for the transition from n=1 to n=2.

title: Energy Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the energy difference E_{n2} - E_{n1} in the calculation of the transition probabilities.

title: Validity Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should specify the conditions under which time-dependent perturbation theory is valid, including the smallness of tau and the perturbation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the calculation of the matrix elements or probabilities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide justification for the approximation used in the expression for P2, particularly the condition tau << hbar/(E1 - E2).
